# Escape Tourisms

> Private taxi, sightseeing routes, jeep safaris and tour packages in Munnar, Kerala. Bookings are handled on WhatsApp: +91 94976 65450. Website: https://www.escapetourisms.com

- [Munnar Sightseeing Taxi](https://www.escapetourisms.com/munnar-sightseeing/): fares, popular places and route planning for one-day Munnar sightseeing
- [Mattupetty & Top Station route](https://www.escapetourisms.com/munnar-sightseeing/mattupetty-top-station/)

- [Etios / Sedan Munnar Sightseeing Taxi](https://www.escapetourisms.com/etios-sedan-munnar-sightseeing-taxi/): Etios and Swift Dzire for 1 to 4 travellers, from ₹2,000 per vehicle
- [Innova Pickup & Drop from Munnar](https://www.escapetourisms.com/innova-taxi-pickup-drop-munnar/): resort pickup and drops to Cochin, Alleppey, Varkala, Trivandrum, Tamil Nadu
- [Etios / Sedan Pickup & Drop from Munnar](https://www.escapetourisms.com/etios-sedan-taxi-pickup-drop-munnar/): sedan pickup and drops for 1 to 4 travellers
